 Print ICAI CA Foundation September 2026 toppers ICAI CA Foundation September 2026 result : The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) has announced the toppers of the CA Foundation September 2026 examination along with the results. Kansika from Hisar and Mahek Gupta from Hyderabad have jointly secured the first rank in the examination, scoring 361 marks each out of 400. Both candidates have secured 90.25%. Sparsh Khandelwal from Ajmer and J Jayanth from Chennai have jointly secured the second rank with 359 marks each. They have scored 89.75%. Vaibhavi Singhal from Gwalior has secured the third rank with 358 marks and an overall score of 89.50%. ICAI has also released the overall pass percentage for the September 2026 examination. A total of 19,736 candidates cleared the examination out of 1,04,240 candidates who appeared. The overall pass percentage stands at 18.93%. CA Foundation September 2026 toppers list
 According to the topper list released by ICAI, five candidates have secured the top three ranks in the September 2026 examination. All India Rank Name City Marks Percentage 
 1 Kansika Hisar 361 90.25% 
 1 Mahek Gupta Hyderabad 361 90.25% 
 2 Sparsh Khandelwal Ajmer 359 89.75% 
 2 J Jayanth Chennai 359 89.75% 
 3 Vaibhavi Singhal Gwalior 358 89.50% 
 CA Foundation September 2026: Pass percentage
 As per the result statistics released by ICAI, a total of 1,04,240 candidates appeared for the September 2026 Foundation examination. Of these, 19,736 candidates passed, recording an overall pass percentage of 18.93%. The gender-wise pass percentage is given below: Gender Candidates appeared Candidates passed Pass percentage 
 Male 53,398 10,931 20.47% 
 Female 50,842 8,805 17.32% 
 Total 1,04,240 19,736 18.93% 
 The examination was conducted across 580 centres. CA Foundation September 2026 examination details
 ICAI conducted the CA Foundation September 2026 examinations on September 2, 5, 7 and 9. To qualify for the examination, candidates must secure at least 40% marks in each paper and an overall aggregate of 50%. Candidates who have cleared the Foundation examination can now become eligible to register for the CA Intermediate course, which is the second level of the Chartered Accountancy programme. Those who could not qualify in the September session can appear for the next CA Foundation examination scheduled for January 2027. The January examination will be conducted on January 3, 5, 7 and 9.
